notes: Multi Studio version 3.2.2: **Reset to Original File (Revert Changes)**: Added a safety "Reset File" button to easily undo mistakes. If you cut the wrong subtitle blocks, edited text unintentionally, or reordered items and want to start over, clicking Reset restores your entire document back to its original untouched state from disk. Protected by a confirmation dialog so you never discard unsaved work by accident., **Editor-Integrated Cut Action & Preserved Workspace**: Clicking Cut now directly excises that scene or subtitle block from your active script text in the editor and marks your document as unsaved. Cutting executes silently without unwanted clipboard pollution, without saving immediately, and without clearing or closing your workspace., **Save Prompt with Automatic Destination Detection**: When you are ready to save your cut script, clicking Save (or pressing Cmd+S / Ctrl+S) opens the native save dialog pre-filled with the same destination folder as your original file and a `cut_` prefix by default, giving you full control to confirm the location or pick a new folder., **Direct 1-Click Cut Buttons**: Replaced complex multi-option popovers with a clean, direct Cut button on each row and in bulk actions, complete with helpful hover tooltips., **Default Collapsed Outline Sections**: Document outline sections now start folded and collapsed by default, giving you a clean, high-level overview of major sections without visual clutter. You can expand individual branches with interactive chevrons or expand all sections at once using the header control., **Far-Left Minimalist Outline Toggle**: Relocated the outline toggle button to the far left of the header bar right before the document title. Uses a clean, compact icon with a helpful tooltip, maximizing space for long file names., **Ultra-Smooth Preview Performance**: Replaced scroll-event layout calculations with native, off-thread intersection observers. Scrolling through long Markdown documents remains completely lag-free and responsive at 60–120fps with zero layout stutter or frame drops., **Clean Table Tooltips (No Clunky Labels)**: Replaced bulky static labels like "• Shift-click to select range" with clean, responsive tooltips on checkboxes and action buttons, keeping table headers modern and compact., **Resizable Outline & Preview with Layout Memory**: Effortlessly adjust the width of the document outline sidebar by dragging the divider handle between the outline and the preview. TTS Studio automatically saves and remembers your custom divider dimensions as well as your outline open/closed preferences across app restarts., **Unified Single Header Bar**: Consolidated all controls into a single, clean header bar across both the source panel and full-screen preview. Displays your file name, outline toggle, line/heading counts, and edit/preview switchers on a single row, completely eliminating stacked and duplicated heading rows., **Smooth, Stable Outline Click-to-Scroll**: Clicking any section heading in the outline sidebar smoothly and stably scrolls the preview container directly to that section without jarring layout shifts or window bouncing. Features deterministic heading tracking with full support for Thai and multi-lingual text, a subtle landing pulse highlight, and real-time active heading highlighting as you read., **Typora-Style Document Outline for Markdown Preview**: Added a collapsible, hierarchical outline sidebar to the Markdown preview inspired by Typora. Browse headings at a glance with nested indentation, expand or collapse sections with interactive chevrons, and toggle the entire outline panel open or closed anytime., **Safe Non-Destructive File Saving (`cut_` Prefix)**: Protects your original documents from being overwritten. When you cut subtitle blocks or save your modified script, TTS Studio creates a new file prefixed with `cut_` (e.g. `cut_myscript.md`) in the same folder, keeping your original script file completely untouched and safe., **Buttery-Smooth Drag Re-Ordering**: Reorganizing scene and subtitle block items is now ultra-fast and responsive, remaining completely lag-free even while the rendered Markdown preview and document outline are open side by side., **Table-Only Drag Re-Ordering**: Reorder scene and subtitle block items in the table freely to customize your export order without modifying your original source script text., **Rendered Markdown (.md) Preview**: Added rendered Markdown preview capabilities to the SRT Extractor. Seamlessly toggle between "Edit" and "Preview" in the source panel or switch to the dedicated full-screen "Preview (.md)" view mode to read formatted headings, text, and subtitle code blocks. You can also preview individual blocks as Markdown in the block inspection dialog., **Shift-Click Range Selection**: Quickly select or deselect a contiguous series of subtitle blocks by clicking one item, holding Shift, and clicking another. Works both on the selection checkbox and anywhere on the card row, saving time when managing long multi-scene scripts., **Bulk Cut Selected Blocks**: Select multiple subtitle blocks using checkboxes and cut all of them at once in a single click from your document while keeping your original script file safe on disk.
